title: Connect Markdown source discovery to the compiled runtime

Implementation evidence: this change landed in b5921f9, the commit that added this record, and remains in force at 66e7e45; b5921f9 was pushed without a recorded Verification run, so the record is carried as implemented rather than verified.

source mutation after discovery returns source_changed without Evidence
